decision: Close fixed 1:8 source-attention support and close direct per-layer Phi-3 attention compression under the speed-compatible envelope. Target-aware head support, shared low-rank all-head factors, and structured all-row support all fail by wide margins, while the uncompressed source operator passes but is outside the complete-system cost envelope. Do not run nearby per-layer compression variants. Return to architecture review for a cross-layer capability compiler that uses the existing fast LayerCake transition as the execution carrier instead of reconstructing source blocks.
claim_boundary: Negative fixed structured-support and direct per-layer source-attention compression evidence only; no physical sparse runtime, component, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
